extensionDescription.message: Save the page to your local Netami Pin library in one click. Links wait in a queue while the app is closed.

queueWaiting.message: Netami Pin: $COUNT$ waiting to be sent. Open the settings to see the queue.

badgeQueued.message: Link is in the local Netami Pin queue

badgeWaiting.message: Link is waiting to be sent to Netami Pin

badgeExisting.message: This link is already in Netami Pin

errorInvalidUrl.message: This page can't be saved. Open a page with an HTTP/HTTPS address.

errorUnsupportedScheme.message: This page can't be saved. Only HTTP/HTTPS links are supported.

errorUnavailable.message: Netami Pin didn't answer. The link will be sent again in a minute.

errorHostMissing.message: Netami Pin isn't installed or its installation is damaged. The link waits here.

errorIncompatible.message: The extension doesn't match Netami Pin. Update the extension — the link waits here.

errorIncompatibleApp.message: Netami Pin is older than the extension. Update Netami Pin — the link waits here.

errorInvalidRequest.message: Netami Pin can't save this link.

errorConflict.message: This request was already used for another link. Remove it from the queue.

errorDatabase.message: Netami Pin couldn't save the link. It will be sent again.

errorNoConfirmation.message: No confirmation that the link was saved

optionsLead.message: Pages you save go to the Netami Pin library on this computer.

statusClosedText.message: It starts in the tray when you save a page. Links wait here until then.

statusUpdateText.message: This extension ($MINE$) doesn't match Netami Pin $APP$. Update it in the browser's extension page — links wait here until then.

statusUpdateAppText.message: Netami Pin $APP$ is older than this extension ($MINE$). Update Netami Pin — links wait here until then.

statusMissingText.message: The extension can't find the app on this computer. Install Netami Pin, or reinstall it if it's already there.

queueEmpty.message: Nothing waiting. Click the Netami Pin icon on a page to save it.

optionsFooter.message: Links stay in the browser until Netami Pin confirms them. If the app is closed, saving a page starts it in the tray.
